verdict.rationale: Ollama's own documentation lets users run models locally, where 'nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine', or opt into Ollama's Cloud. That gives a coarse, device-level choice of where data lives (on your own machine versus the vendor cloud). There is no evidence of region selection or data-residency controls for the cloud service. Missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, documented data-storage location policy for cloud usage, residency guarantees or compliance details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models
